entities.name: Malcator
entities.description: Phyrexian loxodon of New Phyrexia, leader of the executors within the Great Synthesis who judges abominations.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Praetor who engineered Malcator from the first captured loxodon.

entities.name: Mirran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War in which the first loxodon was captured.

entities.name: Great Synthesis
entities.description: Phyrexian structure in which Malcator leads the executors.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias engineered the original Malcator from the first loxodon captured in the Mirran-Phyrexian War.
events.quote: The original Malcator was engineered by Jin-Gitaxias from the first loxodon captured during the Mirran-Phyrexian War

events.summary: Malcator oversees Jin-Gitaxias's elite research sectives, reinventing creations that fail the Standards of Purity.
events.quote: Malcator rigorously inspects the outputs of these sectives

relations.note: Engineered him from a captured loxodon.
relations.quote: The original Malcator was engineered by Jin-Gitaxias
